dc_architecture_invalid.why: The power-architecture compare (POST /api/campus-electrical/{name}/dc-architecture/compare) refused an input: an unknown architecture, an unusable request price, discount rate, planning horizon or solver settings, or a saved network without the data-centre load series. Nothing was written. The message and `field` name what to fix, shown in the Power architecture section.

dc_architecture_no_spec.why: The power-architecture compare needs a data-centre project created with a dc_load spec and a saved network; this project has neither. Nothing was written. Create the project from a data-centre template, then compare.

dc_architecture_pue_infeasible.why: The stated PUE is lower than the project's own architecture's conversion losses alone (PUE below 1/efficiency to the rack), so it cannot hold a non-negative overhead. Refused at create (dc_load.pue_at_design) and by the compare; nothing is clipped or written.

dc_architecture_pack_row.why: The defaults pack the compare reads lacks an architecture's efficiency, capex, lifetime or upkeep row, holds a non-real or unranged row, or mixes money years or currencies across the four architectures. The compare fails closed and writes nothing.

dc_architecture_no_energy_price.why: The compare values facility energy at the tariff's energy component, and the project has no readable one (no tariff, or a tiered, export or non-kWh energy item). Give energy_price_per_mwh in the Power architecture section (Expert); it is marked assumed.

dc_architecture_currency_mismatch.why: The tariff's or the price's currency differs from the finance case's or the architecture capex rows' currency, which the GS-01 currency gate refuses. Nothing was written; use a tariff or price in the finance currency.
